title: Products
description: Two products of our own from XionTechs: an AI-powered platform for smart schools and AI-powered timetabling.

head.b: AI for smart schools and timetables.

school.summary: An integrated digital ecosystem that uses AI to enhance learning, streamline administration, and improve student engagement.
school.body: XionTechs built it to deliver personalized learning paths, real-time analytics, automated grading, and smart resource management, so schools can give a more efficient, adaptive, future-ready education.

timetabling.summary: An intelligent scheduling solution that automates the creation and optimization of academic timetables.

features.interface: User-friendly interface for a seamless, intuitive experience.
features.entry: Helps users with data entry and explains application features based on best practices and individual needs.
features.compare: Compares timetables generated from different inputs and constraints.
features.guide: Interactive conversations to understand users' scheduling goals and guide them to optimal solutions.
features.analytics: Analytics: insights into scheduling patterns, room utilization, and capacity planning.
